hooks.command:
F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/workflow.py"; E=$(cat); if [ -f "$F" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then O=$(printf '%s
' "$E" | python3 -B "$F" hook guard) && { [ -z "$O" ] || printf '%s
' "$O"; exit 0; }; fi; if [ -f "$F" ]; then printf '%s
' "$E" | sh "${F%.py}/fallback.sh"; fi; exit 0
F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/workflow.py"; if [ -f "$F" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 -B "$F" hook gate; fi; exit 0
F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/workflow.py"; if [ -f "$F" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 -B "$F" hook context; fi; exit 0

F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/workflow.py"; if [ -f "$F" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -B "$F" hook repair && exit 0; fi; if [ -f "$F" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Workflow kit: python3 could not run the workflow kit (it is missing or failing), so nothing can be checked and a push or a merge is asked first; check python3 --version (3.11 or newer is needed), then start a new session."}'; fi; exit 0
